reason: I'll start by recovering iron from worn red blood cells, following the pictured recycling cells and the first goal.
expectation: I expect the recycling cells to break down the worn cells and make their iron available for reuse, though I don't know exactly how.

alternatives.reason: Growing replacement skin cells is also a clear goal, but I want to follow the iron route first.

effect: The iron is carried in blood, so I can follow it to the bone marrow for reuse.
reaction: It was interesting that proteins carry the recovered iron rather than metallic fragments.
reason: I'll continue the red blood cell route by bringing the iron to the marrow, where developing blood cells are present.
expectation: I expect the marrow to use the recovered iron to help make new red blood cells.

alternatives.reason: Growing skin cells is also a goal, but I'd rather finish following the iron first.

effect: The recovered iron became part of haemoglobin in new red cells, completing that goal. The remaining goal is skin renewal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the iron reused while the marrow's stem cells remained.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it supplies the dividing skin cells with materials for growth.
expectation: I expect the cells at the skin's base to produce replacement cells while some base cells remain.

effect: The skin result completes the second goal and shows new cells replacing shed cells while the base population remains.
reaction: The continuous covering made the replacement process easy to picture.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following recovered iron into new red blood cells was most worthwhile: it connected recycling old cells to making the oxygen-carrying protein in new ones.

leastWorthwhile.text: Growing skin cells was clear but felt less like a decision because it was the only combination offered at that point.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the recovered iron travels in blood carried by proteins, rather than as metallic fragments.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the pictures and goals explained both replacement routes, though the compatible pairings were supplied.

continue.text: I might continue to see another connected body process, though this short chapter offered limited meaningful choices.
